questions.question:
Identify the sentence that correctly uses inversion to emphasize the adverbial phrase.

A) Never before have I seen such a beautiful sunset.
B) Only after the storm passed did the children go out to play.
C) So fast was the car moving that it almost hit the pedestrian.
D) Hardly had she arrived when the power cut started.
options: Never before have I seen such a beautiful sunset.
Only after the storm passed did the children go out to play.
So fast was the car moving that it almost hit the pedestrian.
Hardly had she arrived when the power cut started.
questions.answer: Only after the storm passed did the children go out to play.

questions.question:
Which of the following sentences correctly employs a cleft sentence to highlight the specific location?

A) It was in the old library that the historian discovered the ancient manuscript.
B) The old library was the place where the historian discovered the ancient manuscript.
C) The historian discovered the ancient manuscript in the old library.
D) The ancient manuscript was discovered by the historian in the old library.
options: It was in the old library that the historian discovered the ancient manuscript.
The old library was the place where the historian discovered the ancient manuscript.
The historian discovered the ancient manuscript in the old library.
The ancient manuscript was discovered by the historian in the old library.
questions.answer: It was in the old library that the historian discovered the ancient manuscript.

questions.question:
Select the option that correctly uses the third conditional to express a hypothetical situation in the past that did not happen.

A) If I had known about the meeting, I would have attended it.
B) If I had studied harder, I would have passed the exam.
C) If I had realised the train was late, I would have waited longer.
D) If I had been aware of the deadline, I would have submitted the report earlier.
options: If I had known about the meeting, I would have attended it.
If I had studied harder, I would have passed the exam.
If I had realised the train was late, I would have waited longer.
If I had been aware of the deadline, I would have submitted the report earlier.
questions.answer: If I had realised the train was late, I would have waited longer.

questions.question:
Which sentence correctly uses the subjunctive mood to express a formal recommendation?

A) The committee recommended that all members attend the meeting.
B) The committee recommends that all members attend the meeting.
C) The committee recommend that all members attend the meeting.
D) The committee recommending that all members attend the meeting.
options: The committee recommended that all members attend the meeting.
The committee recommends that all members attend the meeting.
The committee recommend that all members attend the meeting.
The committee recommending that all members attend the meeting.
questions.answer: The committee recommended that all members attend the meeting.

questions.question:

He is taller than his brother, but she is shorter than her sister.


A) He is taller than his brother, but she is shorter than her sister.
B) He is taller than his brother, but she is shorter than her.
C) He is taller than his brother, but she is shorter.
D) He is taller than his brother, but she is shorter than hers.
options: He is taller than his brother, but she is shorter than her sister.
He is taller than his brother, but she is shorter than her.
He is taller than his brother, but she is shorter.
He is taller than his brother, but she is shorter than hers.
questions.answer: He is taller than his brother, but she is shorter than her sister.
